ValidationRule.description: This rule ensures that Notes field is populated whenever Concessions is marked as Waived or Reduced
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Pricing_Upgrade_Concessions__c, 'Waived'), ISPICKVAL(Pricing_Upgrade_Concessions__c, 'Reduced') ), OR( ISBLANK(Notes__c ), ISNULL(Notes__c) ), NOT($Permission.Bypass_Price_Increase_Validation_Rules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add notes for Waived/Reduced Concessions.
